summary: A generic community app for sharing recipes, with basic moderation and planning features.

tasks.title: Accounts and profiles
acceptance: Users can sign up and sign in
Users can edit a display name and bio
verification_steps: Create a user account and sign in
Edit profile and confirm changes persist
Refresh page and confirm session remains valid

tasks.title: Recipe CRUD + search
acceptance: Users can create and view a recipe
verification_steps: Verify list and detail pages load correctly
Search by keyword and confirm expected filtering

tasks.title: Reporting and moderation basics
work: Add report button for user-generated content
Create a simple moderation queue view
acceptance: Users can submit a report with a reason
verification_steps: Submit a report on a recipe
View it in the moderation queue
Hide and restore the item and confirm UI updates

tasks.title: Favorites and planning list
work: Create a planning list (e.g., week list)
Allow adding/removing items from the list
acceptance: Users can favorite and unfavorite recipes
Users can add recipes to a planning list
Planning list persists for the user
verification_steps: Favorite a recipe and verify it appears in favorites
Add 2 recipes to a planning list and refresh
